eventDetail.scope: The 8th International Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Control and Artificial Intelligence (RICAI 2026) serves as a premier forum for advancing the theoretical foundations and practical applications at the intersection of intelligent systems. The conference welcomes original research contributions spanning autonomous robotics, intelligent control methodologies, and artificial intelligence technologies. Topics of interest include robot perception and navigation, advanced control algorithms, human-robot interaction, machine learning for robotic systems, intelligent manufacturing, and emerging applications in healthcare, agriculture, and extreme environments. We invite high-quality submissions that present novel technical contributions, experimental validations, or significant system implementations that advance the state of the art in these convergent disciplines.
